title: Configuring Team Permissions on World Blue
summary: This document explains how to configure team permissions on World Blue by planning a role structure across up to 4 tiers, creating tiers with defined allowed actions (viewing balances, preparing payments, approving disbursements, administering settings), and setting approval flows for sensitive actions.
